messages:
ana: quick design convo 1: prompt-sets & evals. Need decisions: staged review queue vs instant approve, compact vs annotated diffs default, undo timing, and SR/keyboard behavior. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 91-96) :eyes:
kevin: my read: avoid blocking confirm modals for common flows. propose staged review queue as the default for multi-reviewer suites; instant approve allowed for tiny batches.
sasha: agree on staged default. UX idea: when items are staged show a thin non-modal drawer with counts + per-item unstage. Finalize action in the drawer creates audit entry.
maria: thresholds: <=40 items = instant approve + 12s undo banner; 41-400 = stage (drawer) with quick revert; >400 = kickoff async job (job id + progress card). Org admins can configure cutoffs.
tom: accessibility: undo banner must be announced (role=alert + aria-live=assertive). When undo/finalize occurs, move focus to a predictable element (table header or the job card) and expose a focusable status link.
kevin: keyboard: allow range-select w/ shift+arrow, `S` to stage, `F` to finalize from drawer, and `Ctrl+Z` to undo while the banner is visible. Document shortcuts in `?` help.
eva-bot: visual-scan: compact-mode change markers (purple token) fail AA at 12px. Recommend color #072146 or 13px 600 weight.
sasha: for compact mode, preserve density but increase label weight to 600 and bump to 13px; fallback is adopting #072146 token. Also add a setting to prefer patterned overlays for heatmaps (for colorblind support).
maria: scorecard wording: replace ambiguous "No judgement yet" with "Not scored" and add an info tooltip "Scores: 0 (fail) 1 5 (excellent)." Tooltip must be keyboard accessible.
tom: annotated diffs should auto-collapse identical spans by default; provide an "Expand all" button. For collapsible groups use aria-expanded + aria-controls and support arrow keys to move between groups.
kevin: microcopy: change "Select all in view" -> "Select visible examples (approx.)". Show exact confirmed counts in the staging drawer or job modal to avoid billing confusion.
sasha: staged drawer UX: each staged row should show a subtle "staged" badge with aria-label="staged for review"; allow inline unstage. Drawer shows exact count and a "Preview impact" link for admins.
eva-bot: regression test rs-compact-176 flagged keyboard nav when inline comment is present in compact diffs. Likely tabindex or event-propagation.
kevin: i'll take rs-compact-176. quick fix: ensure inline controls are tabindex=0 and that row arrow handlers check event.target to avoid hijacking. PR by EOD.
maria: QA checklist updates: SR walkthrough for staging & finalize; keyboard shortcuts test; undo announce and focus restore; compact contrast checks; heatmap pattern toggle.
ana: closing this thread after PR links + ticket numbers are added.
